zgloszenie.wstep: Describe what happened. The app log is sent with the description, so the author can find the cause faster.
zgloszenie.opis_przyklad: E.g. the treadmill disconnects after a few minutes, or the character does not run in the game.
zgloszenie.blad.pusty: Describe what happened. One sentence is enough.
zgloszenie.blad.krotki: The description is too short. Add {liczba} more {liczba, plural, one {character} other {characters}}, e.g. what went wrong.
zgloszenie.okres_dostepnosc: Which period of the log to attach
zgloszenie.okres_opis: The package is 2 MB at most. For a longer period, it gets the newest part of the log.
zgloszenie.dolaczone1: the app and Bluetooth log from the chosen period,
zgloszenie.dolaczone2: the last diagnostic report, if there is one,
zgloszenie.dolaczone3: the app and Windows version, control settings and the treadmill model.
zgloszenie.niedolaczone: We do not attach passwords, files from your computer, pressed keys or step history. The Windows user name and the addresses of other Bluetooth devices are removed.
zgloszenie.droga: The report goes through the {serwer} server straight to the author’s inbox. The server stores nothing.
zgloszenie.przygotuj_email: Prepare an e-mail with the report
zgloszenie.zapisz_podpowiedz: Saves the package with the log to a file, so you can send it yourself, e.g. by e-mail.
zgloszenie.wyslano: Report no. {numer} sent. Thank you, the author got the description and the log.
zgloszenie.email_gotowy: An e-mail to the author and the folder with the {plik} package have opened. Drag the file into the message and send it.
zgloszenie.zapisano: Saved the {plik} package. Its folder has opened alongside. Send it by e-mail to {email_autora}.
zgloszenie.blad.paczka: Could not prepare the report. Try again. ({szczegoly})
zgloszenie.blad.za_duza: The package is too big. Choose a shorter period in When the problem happened and try again.
zgloszenie.blad.adres: The report server address in the configuration is wrong.
zgloszenie.blad.odrzucone: The server did not accept the report. Save the package to disk and send it by e-mail. (code {kod})
zgloszenie.blad.za_duza_serwer: The package is too big to send. Save it to disk and send it by e-mail.
zgloszenie.blad.limit: Many reports have been sent already. Try again in an hour or save the package to disk.
zgloszenie.blad.mail: The server could not send the report right now. Save the package to disk and send it by e-mail to {email_autora}.
zgloszenie.blad.internet: Could not send the report. Check the internet connection or save the package to disk.
zgloszenie.droga_ogolna: The report goes through the WalkLevel server straight to the author’s inbox. The server stores nothing.
zgloszenie.droga_email: An e-mail to the author and the folder with the package will open. Just drag the file into the message.
zgloszenie.wyslano_bez_numeru: Report sent. Thank you, the author got the description and the log.
zgloszenie.blad.mail_serwer: {powod} Save the package to disk and send it by e-mail to {email_autora}.
zgloszenie.trwa: The report is already being prepared…
